headline: US approves 621.9 million dollar F 16 sustainment package for Ukraine
label: NEWS
caption:
US officials just greenlit major military support for Kyiv 🇺🇸

According to reports from Firstpost and Anadolu Ajansi, the United States has approved a 621.9 million dollar F 16 sustainment sale to Ukraine.

The package provides vital maintenance, equipment and support for the fighter jets.

Further details on the delivery timeline have not yet been fully outlined.

Would this aid change the course of the conflict in the region?
